title: Gluten-Free German Pork Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish adapted to be gluten-free, featuring pork cutlets breaded and fried to a crispy perfection.
instructions: 1. Season the pork cutlets with salt and pepper.
2. In a shallow dish, combine the gluten-free flour and quick-stir batter mix.
3. In a separate shallow dish, place the crisp german breadcrumbs.
4. Dredge the pork cutlets in the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
5. Dip the flour-coated pork cutlets in the breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
6. Heat the fryer oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F.
7. Fry the breaded pork cutlets in batches for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
8. Remove the fried pork cutlets from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Serve the pork cutlets hot with a squeeze of lemon juice, if desired.
